build_box2box_transform: build a Box2BoxTransform instance with custom weights and scale clamp for R-CNN box regression
create_box2box_transform_rotated: create a Box2BoxTransformRotated instance for rotated R-CNN box regression with 5 deltas
create_box2box_transform_linear: create a Box2BoxTransformLinear instance for FCOS-style linear box regression
test_apply_deltas: test the Box2BoxTransform apply_deltas method to transform source boxes using regression deltas
test_get_deltas: test the Box2BoxTransform get_deltas method to compute deltas from source to target boxes
